info.name: AttackAware 3.0 API
info.description:
Full API collection for AttackAware 3.0 backend.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}} (default: http://localhost:5000)

AUTH: All protected routes use httpOnly cookies. Enable 'Automatically follow redirects' OFF and 'Send cookies' ON in Postman settings.

QUICK START:
1. Run 'Login' → cookies set automatically
2. Run 'Get Current User' → copy userId
3. Run 'Get All Companies' (super_admin) → copy companyId
4. Update collection variables below

ROLE GUIDE:
- super_admin: Full access, all companies, content creation
- admin: Scoped to own company, campaigns, employees
- employee: Own data only, training, progress
- Public: /api/contact POST, /api/track/* (no auth)

SEED CREDENTIALS (after running npm run seed):
- super_admin: admin@attackaware.com / password123
- admin: admin1@company1.com / password123
- employee: emp1_<companyId>@mail.com / password123
